content.short: Zellic is a security research firm with deep expertise in blockchain security and cryptography.
content.description: Zellic specializes in securing emerging technologies by identifying and documenting vulnerabilities across high-value targets, from Fortune 500 firms to DeFi platforms. Developers, founders, and investors rely on Zellic's security assessments to move fast and with confidence, knowing their products are less likely to harbor critical weaknesses. Drawing on real-world offensive security research, Zellic shines a light on blind spots others may miss, helping teams build safer systems.
